Only daughter of the owner of a well-established (?) Gothic (Lolita) maid cafe featuring Japanese-style sweets. Yuzu is a thoughtful and hardworking employee at her family's shop. But at rare cases she will show her clumsy side too. Though lately she has been worrying about her becoming even more clumsy. Her young appearance cannot be ignored even by people who know her real age, thus many people still treat her like a child and try protect her. It doesn't help the situation at all that what they're getting from her in return for their treatment is her acting clumsy. So this make her worry about it even more. Yuzu has a desire to become an adult as soon as possible, therefore she has been drinking black coffee and stretching her limits.

When in class, she is sociable and bright. She lives in the same condo as Akira, so she likes to come over to her room and eat snacks with her.

Usually, when something bad happens, Alina starts speaking haltingly because she is still not very good at Japanese. Although she must have come from Finland, it is pointed out that she often uses Russian words mixed with Japanese.
